about: v2: B11 Arc of Ages east platform (step 2) separated from the north platform (step 5)

entries.why: step 2 and step 5 used points 185 apart with radius 1500, so one visit finished both; walkthrough 199 'step onto the East Platform': the Mage Tower model (b-rndtw4, fixture 2882 at Campacorentin 14080,5952, yaw 180) has three raised platforms; the east one is centred at Campacorentin 15496,6088 (the Albion banner at 15496,6432 stands on its edge); radius 450 covers it and stays 1.9k from the north platform
